p: temple of the LORD: That is, to offer incense against the word of God, which is spoken of in the commendation of Jotham.
corruptly: They were not completely purged from idolatry.
gate of the house of the: Which was 60 cubits high and was for the height called Ophel: it was at the east gate and mention is made of it in 2Ch 3:4.
because he prepared his ways before: He shows that all prosperity comes from God, who never fails when we put our trust in him.
